text: Bit of indigestion going up past the allotments again. Sat on the wall a minute, grand once I got moving.
Heartburn on the hill bit again. Slowed right down, came right after.
Dodgy stomach on the incline, had to ease off for a bit. Fine by the top.
Yesterday's walk, the hill bit - it went up into my jaw for a minute or two. Sat on the wall about ten minutes. Went off, finished the walk after. Never said anything to Pam about it.
Same old business on the hill stretch, heartburn I suppose. Right as rain once I sat a minute.
